why: The pilot compared a learner that cannot carry knowledge across campaigns against a model-predictive controller that is explicitly initialized with a carried posterior (fixed_theta_belief(retained_prior)), while the rollout additionally reset the recurrent state at every campaign boundary (episode_start=True). Any head-to-head reading of that pilot conflates architecture with information rights. This contract fixes the design before any further training so the comparison answers the intended question.
question: Given the SAME causal history and the SAME retention rights as the retained belief-MPC, can a neural controller match or exceed it on the oracle capture metric?

design.meta_episode: 12 consecutive campaigns per history, the same structure the retained MPC is evaluated on
design.physical_reset: physical state is reset between campaigns; only knowledge crosses the boundary
design.retention_rights: the retained learner arm carries its recurrent state across campaign boundaries within a history (episode_start=True only at the start of the whole history); the reset arm receives an identical model and identical compute but its state is reset at every campaign boundary
design.belief_parity: any carried belief summary supplied to the MPC must be supplied to the learner in the same observation slots, or the learner must be explicitly classified as a within-campaign comparator
design.memoryless_architectures: PPO-MLP and KAN-PPO cannot retain history by construction; they either receive the same causal context summary or are reported as within-campaign comparators, never as failed retained arms
design.identical_history: learner and MPC are evaluated on the identical causal history, CRN-paired
design.splits: train, checkpoint-selection and test are disjoint; the best static bar is selected on calibration and frozen before the test block is touched
design.frontiers: fresh exact 4^8 frontiers are enumerated for the confirmatory block; no frontier is reused from the burned set

arms.role: Garrido's bar; selected on calibration, frozen before test
the treatment: neural accumulation with matched rights
David's candidate; admitted only with verified environment and rights parity
post-hoc exact ceiling; a grading device, never a deployable comparator

reporting_rules.three_numbers: every capture figure is reported as pooled over all campaigns, conditional on campaigns with headroom, and the penalty incurred on zero-headroom campaigns; the pooled figure is never reported alone
reporting_rules.no_architecture_ranking_without_tuning: MLP vs LSTM vs KAN may not be ranked unless each has received a documented, comparable tuning budget
reporting_rules.learning_claim: a learner is credited with learning only against a paired comparison with its own initialization AND a fresh holdout, never from a mean curve alone
reporting_rules.ceiling_scope: ceiling-based bounds are always stated with their three qualifiers: that action space, those campaigns, that decision threshold

gates.parity: the parity self-check must pass before any result is read: retained and reset arms must differ ONLY in the retention flag, verified by an identical-configuration assertion
gates.match_mpc: recurrent_ppo_retained - mpc_retained clustered LCB95 >= -0.02 to claim parity with the structured controller
gates.beat_mpc: recurrent_ppo_retained - mpc_retained clustered LCB95 > 0 to claim a learner premium
gates.sanity: recurrent_ppo_retained - recurrent_ppo_reset > 0 is required before any retention claim is made

sequencing: no further training on the superseded pilot design; the parity self-check runs first, then the development block, and only a passing development result may open a sealed confirmatory block
invariants: the frozen c256 comparator, its receipt and its Pareto artifacts stay byte-untouched
the oracle grading module and its self-checks are unchanged
no sealed seed is opened by this contract
